def dec(xi,c,g,u,lo,hi,thr=0.0):
    x=torch.tensor(xi).float(); c=torch.tensor(c).float(); F=torch.zeros(x.shape[0])
    for k in range(20):
        t=torch.full((x.shape[0],),1-k/20)
        v,A=net.velocity(x,t,c,("out_act",),count=False)

        x=x-v/20
    return x.numpy(),F.numpy()
